summary: If 1 ≤ j ≤ m, L is θ_j with its values restricted: they are forms of the right type with principal level at the chosen places. Otherwise the condition is void.

steps.claim: By cases on whether 1 ≤ j ≤ m.
steps.lean:
by_cases (fun h ↦ ⟨.codRestrict _
  ((AuxPair.θ _).codRestrict _ (theta_eq_smul_star_lift_swap _ · ▸ SMulMemClass.smul_mem _
  (by simpa using! (((D.fitsParams_auxPair ϑ ⟨j, h⟩).isEdge.isArrow _ _ (auxDatum _).2).2 ⟨_,
  (isForm_ofAlgForm (isHCParam_paramV _) _).conj⟩).2.conj))) fun Ξ ↦ mem_levelSpace_formRep_iff.2
  fun | _, ⟨k, _, rfl⟩ => by simpa using!
  theta_mul_eq_theta_formAction (s := 1) _ k ‹_› Ξ, by tauto⟩) (by simp [·])

steps.claim: Case 1 ≤ j ≤ m: take for L the map Ξ ↦ θ_jΞ with its values restricted to principalForms(D, W_j).

steps.claim: θ_jΞ is a form of type typeKernel(paramW) on W_j: by theta_eq_smul_star_lift_swap it is a multiple of the conjugate of the descent of the conjugate of F_Ξ, and the pair (W_j, V_j) is an edge of the real parameters (fitsParams_auxPair … isEdge.isArrow), so the descent of a form of parameter paramV is a form of the parameter of W_j (isForm_ofAlgForm).

θ_jΞ has the principal level at the chosen places: for k in that level, the reduction s of k is 1, so (θ_jΞ)(g·k) = θ_j(1·Ξ)(g) = (θ_jΞ)(g) (theta_mul_eq_theta_formAction with s = 1; mem_levelSpace_formRep_iff).

steps.claim: By construction L(Ξ) = θ_jΞ for every Ξ.
Case j ∉ [1, m]: the required implication holds for any L (its hypothesis fails), e.g. L = 0.
